title: SPIRAL: Self-Play on Zero-Sum Games Incentivizes Reasoning via Multi-Agent Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Bo Liu、Simon Yu、Zichen Liu、Leon Guertler、Penghui Qi、Daniel Balcells、Mickel Liu、Cheston Tan、Weiyan Shi、Min Lin、Wee Sun Lee、Natasha Jaques
paper_type_zh: 多智能体自博弈环境与在线轨迹构建方法
best_for_zh: 关注环境式 reasoning data、在线课程、多智能体 RL、RLVR 与 rollout 审计的研究者
one_line: Generates an evolving online stream of multi-turn reasoning and action trajectories through shared-policy self-play in rule-scored zero-sum games.
在规则可评分的零和游戏中让同一策略扮演双方，在线生成多轮推理与动作轨迹；其价值是把环境反馈变成数据构造循环，但并未冻结可审计的在线 rollout 数据。
why: It turns game rules, transitions, and terminal outcomes into a post-training data construction loop while exposing the difference between an open recipe and a frozen, auditable rollout release.
inclusion_reason: Provides an open environment-driven construction recipe in which a shared policy creates a changing stream of multi-turn reasoning-and-action trajectories and receives rule-grounded terminal feedback through zero-sum self-play.

title: Problem
问题
html:
SPIRAL asks whether an LLM can acquire transferable reasoning without a fixed corpus of human-written problems and answers: the model instead learns from multi-turn competition against its current self, with rules and game outcomes supplying feedback. The camera-ready arXiv v3 is marked “Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026”; the arXiv record was first submitted on 30 June 2025 and the official OpenReview entry is the venue record. (Paper p. 1; arXiv record; OpenReview forum 7Yayy5fNLg.)

The object being constructed is not a static QA pair. A training episode begins from a TextArena game and initial state, alternates role-conditioned natural-language observations and complete reasoning/action responses from one shared policy, executes parsed actions, and ends with an environment outcome. The learner attaches a role return, a per-game/per-role EMA baseline, and a role advantage to the policy's turns. For Kuhn Poker and Simple Negotiation, earlier actions are concatenated into the current observation to preserve a Markovian context. (Paper §3, Algorithm 1; Appendix D.1.)

This belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because the changing policy, opponent, and environment jointly generate the training stream. It is adjacent to agent-trajectory and RLVR work, but it is not a frozen trajectory dataset, a step-level process-supervision release, or evidence that natural-language reasoning is faithful. The L4 boundary is therefore the open construction recipe plus verified paper, code, environments, configuration, models, and comparison-dataset URL; the exact online rollouts behind reported checkpoints are not released as immutable data.

SPIRAL 研究的是：LLM 能否不依赖固定的人写问题—答案语料，而是通过与“当前版本的自己”进行多轮对抗，在游戏规则与终局结果提供的反馈下获得可迁移推理能力。arXiv v3 的 camera-ready 首页标注“Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026”；arXiv 记录显示首版提交于 2025 年 6 月 30 日，官方 OpenReview 条目是会议记录。（论文第 1 页；arXiv 记录；OpenReview forum 7Yayy5fNLg。）

这里构造的对象不是静态 QA 对。一个训练 episode 从 TextArena 游戏和初始状态开始，同一共享策略按照角色交替接收自然语言 observation、生成完整的 reasoning/action response，再执行解析后的动作，最终由 environment 给出结果。learner 将角色回报、每个游戏/角色单独维护的 EMA baseline 以及 role advantage 附着到该策略产生的各回合上。对 Kuhn Poker 与 Simple Negotiation，论文把历史动作拼接进当前 observation，以维持 Markovian context。（论文 §3、Algorithm 1；Appendix D.1。）

它归入 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes，因为训练流由持续变化的 policy、opponent 与 environment 共同生成。它与 agent trajectory 和 RLVR 相邻，但不是冻结的轨迹数据集，也不是 step-level process supervision 发布，更不能证明自然语言 reasoning 是 faithful 的。其 L4 证据边界是：论文、代码、环境、配置、模型与对比数据集 URL 均已核验，开放的是构造 recipe；支撑论文 checkpoint 的精确在线 rollout 并未以 immutable data 形式发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SPIRAL's contribution is an online data-and-optimization loop in which one full-parameter LLM plays both roles in turn-based zero-sum language games, so every policy update changes both the data generator and the next opponent. Role-specific top-level instructions distinguish the players; TextArena parses each complete multi-token response into an executable action and advances the state. (Paper §3, Figure 3, Algorithm 1.)

Role-conditioned Advantage Estimation (RAE) maintains a separate EMA return baseline b[G,p] for every game G and role p, then uses A[G,p] = R[p] - b[G,p] for the role's full responses. This centers feedback for asymmetries such as first-move or information advantage. RAE does not score individual reasoning sentences. The feedback contract observes valid actions, state transitions, termination, and role outcomes; it does not observe whether the stated chain-of-thought is true, necessary, or causally responsible for the action. (Paper Eq. 2–3.)

The direction is environment-generated online reasoning data with a co-evolving curriculum. The paper contrasts SPIRAL with SPAG's offline single-game updates, fixed-opponent training, single-agent multi-turn systems such as RAGEN, and single-turn self-generated tasks such as Absolute Zero. What changes is the combination of shared-policy two-role self-play, full online updates, multiple multi-turn games, and measured transfer outside the games—not the invention of self-play, REINFORCE, language games, or rule-based terminal rewards. (Paper §2.)

SPIRAL 的贡献是一个在线数据—优化闭环：同一个 full-parameter LLM 在回合制零和语言游戏中扮演双方，因此每次 policy update 都同时改变后续的数据生成器与对手。角色专属顶层指令区分两名玩家；TextArena 将每个完整的 multi-token response 解析成可执行动作并推进状态。（论文 §3、Figure 3、Algorithm 1。）

Role-conditioned Advantage Estimation（RAE）为每个游戏 G 与角色 p 单独维护 EMA 回报 baseline b[G,p]，再用 A[G,p] = R[p] - b[G,p] 训练该角色的完整 response。这会消除先手优势、信息不对称等结构差异带来的偏移。RAE 并不会给单句 reasoning 打分。该 feedback contract 能观察动作是否合法、状态转移、终止与角色结果，却不能观察显式 chain-of-thought 是否真实、是否必要，或是否在因果上产生了该动作。（论文 Eq. 2–3。）

它代表的方向是由 environment 生成、课程与 policy 共同演化的在线 reasoning data。论文将 SPIRAL 与 SPAG 的离线单游戏更新、固定对手训练、RAGEN 等 single-agent multi-turn 系统，以及 Absolute Zero 等 single-turn 自生成任务进行对比。真正变化的是 shared-policy 双角色自博弈、完全在线更新、多种多轮游戏与跨游戏迁移证据的组合；self-play、REINFORCE、语言游戏和基于规则的终局 reward 本身并非本文首创。（论文 §2。）

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are a base model, a set of two-player TextArena games, role/game prompts, environment transition and action-parsing code, and an initial-state sampler. SPIRAL samples a game and state, assigns the active role, obtains a structured observation, and asks the shared policy for a complete response containing reasoning and an action. The parser extracts the action; the environment advances the state; turns alternate until normal termination, an invalid action, or the implementation's maximum-turn truncation. The collected object is a policy-dependent sequence of observations, responses, parsed actions, transitions, role returns, and game identity. (Paper §3 and Algorithm 1; official repository train_spiral.py.)

For normal game termination, the paper defines sparse returns R0 ∈ {-1,0,1} and R1 = -R0. RAE updates a separate baseline for each game/role with EMA decay 0.95 and applies the resulting scalar advantage to all complete responses from that role; response-length normalization is disabled. The current repository adds two implementation branches that matter for audit: an invalid action immediately terminates with -1.5 for the actor and 0.5 for the other player, while maximum-turn truncation produces 0/0. Zero-advantage trajectories are filtered by default. These code paths should not be silently equated with the paper's normal zero-sum outcome equation.

The main paper reports 400 policy-iteration steps with 128 samples per step on 8 H100 GPUs. Appendix D Table 6 fixes AdamW, learning rate 1e-6, batch size 128, discount 1.0, EMA decay 0.95, two proximal update epochs, policy clipping 0.2, gradient clipping 1.0, weight decay 0, temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, top-k -1, and zero KL coefficients. It reports an 8,192-token maximum response. The checked run.sh at commit 068b06f6afce2e45ae3eb5d8bf677e9d69c83642 is a Kuhn Poker Qwen3-4B-Base example with 4,096 generated tokens, 32,768 context length, and max_train=51200; this is a released example, not proof that it exactly reproduces every paper run.

Training consumes the live environment stream through on-policy policy-gradient updates. Evaluation is zero-shot except for base-model few-shot prompts following the Qwen3 report, uses temperature 0.6/top-p 0.95, and covers eight academic benchmarks plus held-out games. The paper states that no benchmark-related problems or mathematics data enter SPIRAL training, but supplies no item-level overlap report. Reproduction should pin the repository commit, Oat/vLLM/TextArena versions, model revision, game IDs, prompt templates, parser, seeds, rollout batches, checkpoints, and reward branches, and should archive the generated game-state JSON/pickle files.

The separate SFT baseline is built from approximately 25,000 winning trajectories generated by Qwen3-32B self-play. Its official Hugging Face URL is verified, but it is not the online SPIRAL stream. During this curation pass the Dataset Viewer endpoint was unavailable, so its exact row count, schema, splits, and license remain unverified.

输入包括 base model、一组双人 TextArena 游戏、角色/游戏 prompt、environment transition 与 action parser，以及初始状态采样器。SPIRAL 先抽取游戏与状态、确定当前角色、取得结构化 observation，再让共享策略生成同时包含 reasoning 和 action 的完整 response。parser 提取动作，environment 推进状态；双方交替行动，直到正常终局、invalid action 或实现中的 maximum-turn truncation。最终构造的是随 policy 变化的 observation、response、parsed action、transition、角色回报与 game identity 序列。（论文 §3、Algorithm 1；官方仓库 train_spiral.py。）

对于正常游戏终局，论文定义稀疏回报 R0 ∈ {-1,0,1} 且 R1 = -R0。RAE 以 0.95 的 EMA decay 为每个游戏/角色更新独立 baseline，并把得到的 scalar advantage 施加到该角色的全部完整 response；训练不做 response-length normalization。当前官方仓库另有两个对审计很重要的分支：invalid action 会立即终止，并给行动方 -1.5、另一方 0.5；达到最大回合数则给 0/0。默认还会过滤 zero-advantage trajectory。不能把这些代码路径无条件等同于论文对正常零和终局的公式。

论文主实验报告 400 个 policy-iteration step、每步 128 个 sample，使用 8 张 H100。Appendix D Table 6 固定 AdamW、1e-6 learning rate、batch size 128、discount 1.0、EMA decay 0.95、两次 proximal update epoch、policy clipping 0.2、gradient clipping 1.0、weight decay 0、temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0、top-k -1，以及两个为零的 KL coefficient；表中最大 response 为 8,192 tokens。核验的 commit 068b06f6afce2e45ae3eb5d8bf677e9d69c83642 中，run.sh 是 Qwen3-4B-Base 的 Kuhn Poker 示例，设置 4,096 generated tokens、32,768 context length 与 max_train=51200；它是当前可运行示例，不足以证明能逐项复现论文所有实验。

训练通过 on-policy policy-gradient update 消费实时 environment stream。评测除 base model 按 Qwen3 report 使用 few-shot prompt 外均为 zero-shot，采用 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95，覆盖八个学术 benchmark 与 held-out game。论文声明 SPIRAL 训练没有使用 benchmark-related problem 或数学数据，但未提供 item-level overlap report。复现时应固定 repository commit、Oat/vLLM/TextArena 版本、model revision、game ID、prompt template、parser、seed、rollout batch、checkpoint 与 reward branch，并归档生成的 game-state JSON/pickle。

单独的 SFT baseline 使用 Qwen3-32B 自博弈生成的约 25,000 条 winning trajectory。其官方 Hugging Face URL 已核验，但它不是在线 SPIRAL stream。本次整理时 Dataset Viewer endpoint 不可用，因此其精确行数、schema、split 与 license 仍未核实。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the Table 1 evaluation protocol, Qwen3-4B-Base rises from a 34.0 average over MATH500, AIME24, AIME25, OlympiadBench, AMC-23, Minerva Math, GPQA-Diamond, and MMLU-Pro to 44.5 after multi-game SPIRAL; the 25k multi-game SFT baseline reaches 39.7. Qwen3-8B-Base moves from 39.5 to 49.6, while DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B moves from 60.4 to 61.8. AIME24/25 and AMC23 use AVG@32; the other math benchmarks use PASS@1, and evaluation uses temperature 0.6/top-p 0.95. These numbers establish model changes under the authors' setup, not the intrinsic quality of every generated trajectory. (Paper Table 1; Appendix D.3.)

The v3 appendix adds a three-seed check with seeds 14, 42, and 100. For Qwen3-4B-Base, multi-game SPIRAL reports 44.5 ± 0.5 average versus 39.6 ± 0.4 for multi-game SFT. On higher-complexity game variants, Table 8 reports an OOD average of 36.1 for SPIRAL, 18.4 for SFT, and 11.0 for the base model. These results support repeatability across the reported seeds and transfer to related game mechanics, but not open-ended or non-zero-sum environments. (Appendix E.3–E.5, Tables 8 and 10.)

The mechanism ablation is aligned with the claimed role of RAE. Without RAE, Figure 6 reports response length falling from about 2,000 characters toward zero within roughly 100 policy iterations and general-reasoning score falling from 44% to 40%; with RAE, response length stays near 1,300–1,500 characters and the score rises from 40% to 47%. Appendix Figure 9 reports math performance dropping from 35% to 12% around step 150 and gradients approaching zero after step 200 without RAE. This is evidence that RAE affects stability, not evidence that longer text is faithful reasoning.

The transfer explanation is weaker. GPT-4.1 classifies 290 Kuhn Poker game trajectories and 46,792 mathematical solutions into three discovered patterns. Appendix F says 50 random trajectory samples per checkpoint were used for discovery, followed by large-scale classification and manual spot checks. The labels and examples are judge-mediated post-hoc analysis; no blinded human agreement or causal intervention shows that the identified text patterns caused the benchmark gains.

Artifact evidence is mixed. The official repository exposes training and evaluation code, TextArena integration, game-state dumps, and a runnable command; its checked main commit is 068b06f6afce2e45ae3eb5d8bf677e9d69c83642 and GitHub shows no tagged release. The reported online rollout batches, seeds, rewards, optimizer states, and complete checkpoint lineage are not packaged as immutable per-run artifacts.

按 Table 1 的评测设置，Qwen3-4B-Base 在 MATH500、AIME24、AIME25、OlympiadBench、AMC-23、Minerva Math、GPQA-Diamond 与 MMLU-Pro 八项平均分从 34.0 升至 multi-game SPIRAL 的 44.5；25k multi-game SFT baseline 为 39.7。Qwen3-8B-Base 从 39.5 升至 49.6，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 从 60.4 升至 61.8。AIME24/25 与 AMC23 使用 AVG@32，其余数学 benchmark 使用 PASS@1；评测 temperature 为 0.6、top-p 为 0.95。这些数字说明作者设置下模型发生了变化，并不证明每条生成 trajectory 都具有内在高质量。（论文 Table 1；Appendix D.3。）

v3 附录增加了 seed 14、42、100 的三随机种子检查。对 Qwen3-4B-Base，multi-game SPIRAL 平均分为 44.5 ± 0.5，multi-game SFT 为 39.6 ± 0.4。在复杂度更高的游戏变体上，Table 8 报告 SPIRAL 的 OOD 平均 win rate 为 36.1，SFT 为 18.4，base model 为 11.0。这支持论文所报种子范围内的可重复性以及向相近游戏机制的迁移，但不能外推到开放式或非零和 environment。（Appendix E.3–E.5、Tables 8 和 10。）

机制消融与 RAE 的预期作用一致。Figure 6 报告：移除 RAE 后，response length 在约 100 个 policy iteration 内从约 2,000 字符降至接近零，general-reasoning score 从 44% 降到 40%；保留 RAE 时，response length 维持约 1,300–1,500 字符，score 从 40% 升到 47%。Appendix Figure 9 报告无 RAE 时 math performance 在约 step 150 从 35% 跌至 12%，gradient 在 step 200 后接近零。这证明 RAE 影响训练稳定性，却不能证明更长文本就是 faithful reasoning。

对迁移机制的解释更弱。GPT-4.1 将 290 条 Kuhn Poker game trajectory 与 46,792 条数学 solution 分为三个由数据归纳出的 pattern。Appendix F 说明发现阶段每个 checkpoint 随机抽取 50 条 trajectory，之后做大规模分类与人工 spot check。这些标签和样例属于 judge-mediated post-hoc analysis；论文没有给出 blind human agreement 或 causal intervention，因而不能证明这些文本 pattern 导致了 benchmark 增益。

Artifact 证据强弱不一。官方仓库开放了训练/评测代码、TextArena integration、game-state dump 与 runnable command；核验的 main commit 为 068b06f6afce2e45ae3eb5d8bf677e9d69c83642，GitHub 未显示 tagged release。论文实验对应的在线 rollout batch、seed、reward、optimizer state 与完整 checkpoint lineage 没有被打包成 immutable per-run artifact。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is not “reasoning from games” in general. The paper situates SPIRAL against offline single-game language self-play, LoRA-based multi-agent adaptation, fixed opponents, single-agent multi-turn RL, and single-turn self-generated reasoning tasks. Established components include zero-sum self-play, Monte Carlo policy gradients, TextArena environments, vLLM inference, Oat's actor-learner architecture, and terminal game rewards. (Paper §2–§3.)

The concrete change is the data-generating interface: one shared full-parameter policy plays both roles across multiple multi-turn games, trajectories are consumed online, and the next batch is generated against the updated policy. RAE makes this interface trainable by centering returns for each game/role instead of treating structural role advantage as learning signal. Thus the data distribution, opponent, and learner co-evolve; there is no final fixed prompt pool that explains the recipe.

The direction signal is the conversion of a replayable environment into a post-training source of tasks, traces, and rule-grounded feedback. Evidence for that mechanism includes fixed-opponent comparisons, the RAE collapse ablation, multi-game versus single-game results, higher-complexity game transfer, and three-seed reporting. Conference acceptance and benchmark gains are not themselves quality guarantees, and GPT-4.1 pattern labels remain interpretation rather than a verifier.

What is not new is self-play, terminal reward, REINFORCE, or multi-agent games. The open contribution is also a recipe rather than a complete data release: code and a static SFT comparison set are public, but the policy-dependent online streams are not frozen. Before reuse, inspect parser and invalid-action behavior, environment versions, baseline initialization, truncation, zero-advantage filtering, run seeds, code-license notices, and whether archived rollouts preserve failures as well as wins.

既有工作基线并不是泛泛的“从游戏学习推理”。论文把 SPIRAL 与离线单游戏语言自博弈、基于 LoRA 的多智能体适配、固定对手、single-agent multi-turn RL，以及 single-turn 自生成推理任务进行对比。零和 self-play、Monte Carlo policy gradient、TextArena environment、vLLM inference、Oat actor-learner architecture 与终局游戏 reward 都是已有组件。（论文 §2–§3。）

真正的变化在于数据生成接口：同一个 shared full-parameter policy 在多种 multi-turn game 中扮演双方，trajectory 被在线消费，下一批数据再与更新后的 policy 对弈生成。RAE 针对每个游戏/角色中心化回报，避免把角色的结构性优势当成学习信号，从而使该接口可训练。因此 data distribution、opponent 与 learner 共同演化；不存在一个固定终版 prompt pool 可以单独解释这套 recipe。

其方向意义在于把可 replay 的 environment 转化为 post-training 的 task、trace 与 rule-grounded feedback 来源。支持该机制的证据包括 fixed-opponent 对照、RAE collapse 消融、multi-game 与 single-game 比较、复杂游戏变体迁移以及三随机种子结果。会议接收与 benchmark 增益本身不是数据质量保证，GPT-4.1 pattern label 仍是解释层而不是 verifier。

Self-play、terminal reward、REINFORCE 与 multi-agent game 本身并不新。开放贡献也是 recipe 而非完整 data release：代码和静态 SFT 对比集公开，但随 policy 变化的在线 stream 没有冻结。复用前应检查 parser 与 invalid-action 行为、environment version、baseline 初始化、truncation、zero-advantage filtering、run seed、代码 license notice，以及归档 rollout 是否同时保留失败与成功样本。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors identify four main boundaries: dependence shifts from curated problems to designed games; each run requires substantial compute; evaluation is concentrated on academic benchmarks and zero-shot transfer; and reward hacking remains possible. They report about 25 hours for Qwen3-4B and 28 hours for Qwen3-8B on 8 H100 GPUs and note diminishing returns with longer training. Three small zero-sum games do not establish scalability to open-ended, cooperative, robotics, or very sparse-reward environments. (Appendix B and D.2.)

The environment verifies successful play, not the intermediate explanation. A model can produce a valid action with false or post-hoc reasoning, and the RAE ablation only shows that nonempty output correlates with retained performance. GPT-4.1 pattern classification is not process supervision. Curator inference: any downstream use that treats these traces as faithful demonstrations risks learning game-specific rhetoric or hidden teacher-like policy traits rather than causal reasoning.

The parser and reward implementation enlarge the attack surface. Invalid actions terminate with a special -1.5/0.5 assignment, max-turn truncation gives 0/0, and zero-advantage trajectories may be dropped. Curator inference: a policy can optimize formatting, termination, or environment quirks without learning the intended skill; those branches also complicate the paper's clean zero-sum interpretation. Fixed-opponent exploitation is empirically visible, while self-play exploitation of shared parser or environment artifacts is not stress-tested.

Release completeness limits audit and reproduction. There is no tagged per-experiment bundle containing exact TextArena/Oat/vLLM revisions, prompts, seeds, all valid and invalid turns, rewards, baselines, advantages, optimizer states, and checkpoints. The paper states that no benchmark-related data are used, but no item-level decontamination report is provided. The root repository is MIT licensed while key files carry Apache-2.0 headers, and the static dataset/model licenses and upstream obligations remain unresolved. These gaps block treating the online stream as a ready-to-reuse dataset.

作者明确给出四类边界：依赖从人工整理问题转移到人工设计游戏；每次实验仍需要大量计算；评测集中在学术 benchmark 与 zero-shot transfer；并且 reward hacking 仍然可能发生。论文报告 Qwen3-4B 约需 8 张 H100 训练 25 小时、Qwen3-8B 约需 28 小时，并指出延长训练后的收益趋于饱和。三个小型零和游戏不足以证明方法可扩展到开放式、合作式、机器人或极稀疏 reward environment。（Appendix B、D.2。）

Environment 能验证游戏是否成功，却不能验证中间解释。模型可能在 reasoning 错误或事后编造时仍输出合法 action；RAE 消融只能说明非空输出与性能保持相关。GPT-4.1 pattern classification 也不是 process supervision。Curator inference：若下游直接把这些 trace 当作 faithful demonstration，可能学到游戏专属话术或隐藏的 policy traits，而不是具有因果作用的 reasoning。

Parser 与 reward 实现扩大了可攻击面。Invalid action 使用特殊的 -1.5/0.5 终止分配，达到最大回合数给 0/0，zero-advantage trajectory 还可能被丢弃。Curator inference：policy 可以通过格式、终止条件或 environment bug 获得 reward，而不学习目标技能；这些分支也使论文整洁的零和解释更复杂。论文实证展示了 fixed-opponent exploitation，却没有压力测试 self-play 对共享 parser 或 environment artifact 的利用。

发布完整性限制了审计与复现。没有 tagged per-experiment bundle 同时保存精确 TextArena/Oat/vLLM revision、prompt、seed、全部有效/无效回合、reward、baseline、advantage、optimizer state 与 checkpoint。论文声明未使用 benchmark-related data，但未给出 item-level decontamination report。仓库根目录是 MIT license，而关键文件带有 Apache-2.0 header；静态 dataset/model license 及上游义务也未解决。因此，现有材料不足以把在线 stream 当作可直接复用的数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, SPIRAL is a concrete blueprint for replacing a fixed prompt corpus with an environment-generated online curriculum. A reproduction can reuse the shared-policy two-role loop, per-game/per-role EMA baseline, vectorized actor collection, terminal rule feedback, and periodic game-state dumps. It is particularly useful as an ablation baseline for static demonstrations versus online RL, fixed versus co-evolving opponents, global versus role-conditioned baselines, and single-game versus multi-game curricula.

An auditable implementation should persist game and dependency versions, initial state and seed, role prompt, every observation and complete response, parsed action, action-validity flag, transition, termination reason, terminal return, baseline, advantage, policy checkpoint, and update configuration. It should also retain failed, invalid, zero-advantage, and truncated episodes; run multiple seeds; evaluate parser/environment exploitation; and test reasoning faithfulness separately from win rate and benchmark accuracy.

Reuse class is split by artifact. The code is suitable as a recipe reproduction starting point after pinning commit and dependencies. The paper's reported online stream is reading/audit reference only because it is not frozen. The static Qwen3-32B SFT comparison dataset is blocked for training reuse until its Dataset Viewer schema, split, lineage, and license are independently confirmed. The released models are evaluation or initialization candidates only after their own model cards and licenses are checked.

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track 而言，SPIRAL 是用 environment-generated online curriculum 替代固定 prompt corpus 的具体蓝图。复现者可以借鉴 shared-policy 双角色循环、每个游戏/角色单独的 EMA baseline、vectorized actor collection、终局规则反馈以及周期性 game-state dump。它尤其适合作为以下消融的 baseline：静态 demonstration 与 online RL、固定与共同演化的 opponent、global 与 role-conditioned baseline、single-game 与 multi-game curriculum。

可审计实现应保存游戏与依赖版本、初始状态与 seed、role prompt、每条 observation 与完整 response、parsed action、action-validity flag、transition、termination reason、terminal return、baseline、advantage、policy checkpoint 与 update configuration；还应保留 failed、invalid、zero-advantage 与 truncated episode，运行多个随机种子，评估 parser/environment exploitation，并把 reasoning faithfulness 与 win rate、benchmark accuracy 分开测试。

Artifact 的复用等级需要拆分。代码在固定 commit 与依赖后可作为 recipe reproduction 起点。论文实验的在线 stream 因未冻结，只适合作为 reading/audit reference。静态 Qwen3-32B SFT 对比数据集在其 Dataset Viewer schema、split、lineage 与 license 被独立确认前，训练复用应视为 blocked。公开模型也只能在逐一核对 model card 与 license 后作为评测或初始化候选。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3 and Algorithm 1 first: the essential object is an online sequence of role-conditioned observations, complete reasoning/actions, transitions, and terminal feedback—not a static QA corpus.
  • RAE is a per-game/per-role return baseline; it stabilizes policy gradients but does not verify intermediate reasoning.
  • Table 10 is the cleanest performance check: Qwen3-4B multi-game SPIRAL reports 44.5 ± 0.5 over three seeds versus 39.6 ± 0.4 for multi-game SFT.
  • Compare Appendix D Table 6 with the current run.sh: the paper reports an 8,192-token maximum response, while the released example uses 4,096.
  • Do not merge the approximately 25k Qwen3-32B SFT comparison set with SPIRAL's unfrozen online rollout stream; schema, split, license, and run-level lineage remain open audit items.

• 先读 §3 与 Algorithm 1：核心对象是 role-conditioned observation、完整 reasoning/action、transition 与 terminal feedback 组成的在线序列，而不是静态 QA corpus。
  • RAE 是每个游戏/角色单独维护的 return baseline；它稳定 policy gradient，却不验证 intermediate reasoning。
  • Table 10 是最干净的性能核验：Qwen3-4B multi-game SPIRAL 三随机种子平均为 44.5 ± 0.5，multi-game SFT 为 39.6 ± 0.4。
  • 对照 Appendix D Table 6 与当前 run.sh：论文报告最大 response 为 8,192 tokens，而公开示例使用 4,096。
  • 不要把约 25k 的 Qwen3-32B SFT 对比集与未冻结的 SPIRAL 在线 rollout stream 混为一谈；schema、split、license 与 run-level lineage 都仍是待审计项。

title: Citation

html:

官方入口：ICLR 2026 OpenReview 记录、arXiv v3、代码与 recipe、模型与数据 collection，以及 Qwen3-32B Kuhn Poker SFT 对比数据集。本次核验的 repository commit 是 068b06f6afce2e45ae3eb5d8bf677e9d69c83642；检查时 GitHub 没有 tagged release。

value.html: Structured natural-language observations produced by TextArena for TicTacToe, Kuhn Poker, and Simple Negotiation; for partially observable games the paper concatenates action history into the current observation.

value_zh.html: TextArena 为 TicTacToe、Kuhn Poker 与 Simple Negotiation 产生的结构化自然语言观察；对部分可观察博弈，论文将动作历史拼接到当前观察。

value.html: Each turn is a complete multi-token response with explicit reasoning and an executable action. A conceptual training episode contains the game identity, initial state, alternating role-conditioned observations and responses, parsed actions, transitions, terminal outcome, role return, role baseline, and role advantage. The paper does not publish an immutable row schema for the reported online streams.

value_zh.html: 每回合为带显式推理与可执行动作的完整多 token 回复。概念训练 episode 含博弈身份、初始状态、交替的角色条件化观察与回复、解析动作、转移、终局结果、角色回报、角色基线与角色优势。论文未公布所报告在线流的不可变行 schema。

value.html: One shared current policy plays both roles under role- and game-conditioned prompts; no external teacher generates the online self-play stream.

value_zh.html: 一个共享当前策略在角色与博弈条件化提示下扮演两个角色；无外部教师生成在线自我对弈流。

value.html: Vectorized two-player turn-based TextArena games, with vLLM actors and a centralized Oat learner in the released distributed online actor-learner implementation.

value_zh.html: 向量化双人回合制 TextArena 博弈，已发布的分布式在线 actor-learner 实现中带 vLLM actors 与集中式 Oat learner。

value.html: Game transition rules parse actions and supply sparse terminal feedback. For normal terminal outcomes the paper defines opposite returns in {-1, 0, 1}; the current repository additionally terminates invalid actions with -1.5 for the acting player and 0.5 for the other player, and uses 0/0 on max-turn truncation. RAE subtracts a separate per-game, per-role EMA baseline from each role return.

value_zh.html: 博弈转移规则解析动作并提供稀疏终局反馈。对正常终局结果，论文定义 {-1, 0, 1} 中的相反回报；当前仓库额外以行动玩家 -1.5、另一玩家 0.5 终止无效动作，并在最大回合截断时使用 0/0。RAE 从每个角色回报中减去单独的逐博弈、逐角色 EMA 基线。

value.html: Termination is controlled by the selected TextArena game, an invalid parsed action, or the implementation's maximum-turn truncation. Only the normal game outcome is the paper's zero-sum {-1, 0, 1} contract.

value_zh.html: 终止由所选 TextArena 博弈、无效解析动作或实现的最大回合截断控制。仅正常博弈结果是论文的零和 {-1, 0, 1} 约定。

value.html: Main results cover Qwen3-4B-Base, Qwen3-8B-Base, Octothinker-8B-Base, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B; the released runnable example targets Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base.

value_zh.html: 主结果覆盖 Qwen3-4B-Base、Qwen3-8B-Base、Octothinker-8B-Base、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B；已发布可运行示例针对 Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base。

value.html: No teacher is used for online SPIRAL rollouts. The SFT comparison uses winning self-play trajectories generated by Qwen3-32B.

value_zh.html: 在线 SPIRAL rollouts 不使用教师。SFT 比较使用 Qwen3-32B 生成的获胜自我对弈轨迹。

value.html: One shared on-policy model produces complete reasoning-and-action responses for both players; each update changes the future rollout distribution and opponent.

value_zh.html: 一个共享 on-policy 模型为双方玩家产生完整推理与动作回复；每次更新改变未来 rollout 分布与对手。

value.html: Sample a game and initial state, alternate role-conditioned responses until termination, parse and execute each action, assign role returns, update per-game/per-role EMA baselines, compute RAE advantages, update the shared policy, synchronize weights, and repeat with the new policy.

value_zh.html: 采样一场博弈与初始状态，交替角色条件化回复直至终止，解析并执行每个动作，分配角色回报，更新逐博弈/逐角色 EMA 基线，计算 RAE 优势，更新共享策略，同步权重，并用新策略重复。

value.html: The paper reports 400 policy-iteration steps and 128 samples per step (51,200 samples by arithmetic). It does not report an immutable count of unique games, turns, or released online episodes for each run.

value_zh.html: 论文报告 400 个策略迭代步且每步 128 个样本（按算术为 51,200 个样本）。未报告每次运行的独特博弈、回合或已发布在线 episodes 的不可变计数。

value.html: Training sampling temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, top-k -1; evaluation temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95.

value_zh.html: 训练采样温度 1.0、top-p 1.0、top-k -1；评测温度 0.6 与 top-p 0.95。

value.html: The online loop has no static correctness filter: played turns are retained for policy updates after environment outcomes and RAE. The implementation filters zero-advantage trajectories by default. The separate SFT baseline selects approximately 25,000 winning Qwen3-32B trajectories.

value_zh.html: 在线循环无静态正确性过滤器：已玩回合在环境结果与 RAE 之后保留用于策略更新。实现默认过滤零优势轨迹。单独的 SFT 基线选择约 25,000 条获胜 Qwen3-32B 轨迹。

value.html: Paper Appendix D Table 6 reports an 8,192-token maximum training response. The current released run.sh example instead sets generate_max_length=4,096, max_context_length=32,768, and max_model_len=12,800. Reported compute is about 25 h for Qwen3-4B, 28 h for Qwen3-8B, and 16 h for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Octothinker-8B, each on 8 H100 GPUs.

value_zh.html: 论文 Appendix D Table 6 报告 8,192-token 最大训练回复。当前已发布的 run.sh 示例改为设置 generate_max_length=4,096、max_context_length=32,768 与 max_model_len=12,800。所报告计算约为 Qwen3-4B 25 h、Qwen3-8B 28 h，以及 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Octothinker-8B 各 16 h，均在 8 张 H100 GPU 上。

value.html: Full-parameter online REINFORCE-style policy-gradient training with RAE. Table 6 reports AdamW, constant 1e-6 learning rate, batch size 128, discount 1.0, EMA decay 0.95, two proximal update epochs, clipping 0.2, gradient clipping 1.0, weight decay 0.0, and zero KL loss and penalty coefficients.

value_zh.html: 带 RAE 的全参数在线 REINFORCE 风格策略梯度训练。Table 6 报告 AdamW、恒定 1e-6 学习率、batch size 128、折扣 1.0、EMA 衰减 0.95、两个 proximal 更新 epochs、裁剪 0.2、梯度裁剪 1.0、weight decay 0.0，以及零 KL 损失与惩罚系数。

value.html: Online, policy-dependent trajectories from three procedural games. A separate static Hugging Face artifact contains winning Kuhn Poker expert trajectories for the SFT comparison and is not the online SPIRAL stream.

value_zh.html: 来自三个程序博弈的在线、策略依赖轨迹。单独的静态 Hugging Face 产物含用于 SFT 比较的获胜 Kuhn Poker 专家轨迹，并非在线 SPIRAL 流。

value.html: Training uses one or all of TicTacToe, Kuhn Poker, and Simple Negotiation; evaluation covers held-out games, higher-complexity variants, and eight academic reasoning benchmarks. Immutable per-run split and seed manifests are not released.

value_zh.html: 训练使用 TicTacToe、Kuhn Poker 与 Simple Negotiation 之一或全部；评测覆盖留出博弈、更高复杂度变体与八个学术推理基准。不可变的逐运行划分与 seed 清单未发布。

value.html: The paper states that training uses game states rather than benchmark-related problems or mathematics data. No independent item-level overlap audit or frozen source manifest is released.

value_zh.html: 论文称训练使用博弈状态而非基准相关问题或数学数据。未发布独立的条目级重叠审计或冻结来源清单。

items: Terminal game success validates outcome and executable play, not the truth or causal faithfulness of intermediate reasoning text.

Invalid-action probability compounds across turns; the released implementation uses a special non-zero-sum-looking -1.5/0.5 termination reward that should be audited against the paper's normal zero-sum contract.
Without RAE, the reported policy collapses toward near-empty reasoning, math performance crashes, and gradients approach zero.
Fixed opponents are exploitable; shared-policy self-play can also exploit environment rules, parser behavior, or protocol artifacts not measured by benchmark accuracy.
The reported online streams are stochastic and not frozen with complete rollouts, invalid actions, rewards, seeds, checkpoints, optimizer states, and environment revisions.
The static SFT dataset is a comparison artifact, not a frozen copy of the online SPIRAL training stream.
GPT-4.1 pattern classification is judge-mediated post-hoc analysis rather than process supervision or causal evidence.
终局博弈成功验证结果与可执行对弈，而非中间推理文本的真实性或因果忠实性。
无效动作概率跨回合复合；已发布实现使用看起来非零和的特殊 -1.5/0.5 终止奖励，应对照论文的正常零和约定审计。
没有 RAE 时，所报告策略向近空推理崩溃，数学性能骤降，梯度趋近零。
固定对手可被利用；共享策略自我对弈也可利用环境规则、解析器行为或基准准确率未度量的协议伪迹。
所报告在线流是随机的，且未与完整 rollouts、无效动作、奖励、seeds、checkpoints、优化器状态与环境修订一并冻结。
静态 SFT 数据集是比较产物，不是在线 SPIRAL 训练流的冻结副本。
GPT-4.1 模式分类是评审中介的事后分析，而非过程监督或因果证据。

value.html: The repository root carries an MIT license, while run.sh and train_spiral.py contain Apache-2.0 file headers. Dataset, model, generated-output, TextArena, and base-model obligations require artifact-specific review; the checked official sources do not resolve the mixed code notices into one release-wide statement.

value.html: TextArena rule and initial state -> role-conditioned shared-policy response -> parsed action and transition -> terminal or invalid/truncation outcome -> per-game/per-role EMA baseline and advantage -> shared-policy update -> changed future opponent and trajectory distribution.
